password.title: Password
password.intro: We rely on length rather than complex symbols.
password.minLengthHint: 12 to 36 characters. A person in several organizations follows the longest minimum among them; other organizations' settings are never shown.
password.breachedHint: Checked by the sign-in service when it is turned on for the server.
password.expiryHint: Forced periodic changes lead to weaker passwords, so we don't recommend them.

lockout.title: Account lockout
lockout.scope: Applies to your organization's members when they sign in at your organization's own address; on the shared sign-in page the platform default applies to everyone (5 attempts, 15 minutes). Browsers a member chose to remember can still sign in while sign-in is paused, and you can unlock a member from their profile.
lockout.thresholdHint: 3 to 5 attempts — never more lenient than the platform default (5 attempts).
lockout.minutesHint: 15 to 60 minutes — never shorter than the platform default (15 minutes).

sessions.title: Sign-in sessions
sessions.intro: When signing in again is required.
sessions.idleHint: We warn the user two minutes before it ends so they can continue (5 to 480 minutes).
sessions.devices: Maximum devices at the same time
sessions.devicesHint: When exceeded, the oldest sign-in session ends (1 to 10).

security.noChanges: There are no changes to save.

userImport.intro: You can add many employees at once from an Excel or CSV file. We check every row and show you the outcome before importing; nothing is saved until you confirm.

forbidden.title: You don't have permission to import users
forbidden.body: The Organization Admin and the HR Manager import users. You can contact one of them if you need to add employees.

notYours.title: Someone else started this import
notYours.body: Only the person who started an import follows its steps, because the file holds employees' data. You'll see the result's counts once it ends.

FILE_TYPE.title: This type of file can't be imported
FILE_TYPE.body: By its content, {name} isn't an XLSX or CSV file. You can open it in Excel, save it as XLSX or CSV, and upload it.

FILE_TOO_LARGE.title: The file is larger than allowed
FILE_TOO_LARGE.body: The limit is 20 MB. You can delete columns you don't need, or split the file in two.

FILE_TOO_MANY_ROWS.title: The file has more rows than allowed
FILE_TOO_MANY_ROWS.body: The file has more than 10,000 rows, the limit per file. You can split it in two, for example by branch, and import them one after the other.

FILE_INFECTED.title: We didn't accept the file for security reasons
FILE_INFECTED.body: The scan found malware in the file, so we quarantined it without reading it, and told the Organization Admin. You can scan your device, download the file again from its source and upload it.

FILE_ENCODING.title: The Arabic letters in the file can't be read
FILE_ENCODING.body: The file isn't saved as UTF-8, so Arabic letters show as unreadable symbols. You can save it from Excel as "CSV UTF-8", or upload it as XLSX.

FILE_EMPTY.title: There's no data in the file
FILE_EMPTY.body: We found the header row only, or nothing. People's data starts on the second row, one row per person.

FILE_PROTECTED.title: The file is password-protected
FILE_PROTECTED.body: We can't read a protected file. You can remove the protection in Excel and upload it.

FILE_MACROS.title: A file with macros can't be imported
FILE_MACROS.body: The file is an Excel workbook with macros. You can save it in Excel as a regular XLSX file and upload it.

FILE_TOO_MANY_COLUMNS.title: The file has more columns than allowed
FILE_TOO_MANY_COLUMNS.body: The limit is 200 columns. You can delete columns you don't need and upload it.

FILE_TOO_MANY_SHEETS.title: The file has more sheets than allowed
FILE_TOO_MANY_SHEETS.body: The limit is 50 sheets per file. You can move the employees' sheet into a new file and upload it.

FILE_UNREADABLE.title: The file can't be read
FILE_UNREADABLE.body: The file seems damaged or incomplete. You can open it in Excel, save it again as XLSX or CSV, and upload it.

FILE_SCAN_FAILED.title: The file couldn't be scanned
FILE_SCAN_FAILED.body: The virus scan didn't finish, so we didn't read the file. You can upload it again.

FILE_DELETED.title: The file was deleted before it was read

SYSTEM_FAULT.title: We couldn't read the file because of a fault on our side
SYSTEM_FAULT.body: We tried several times without success, and nothing from the file was saved. You can upload it again.

uploadCut.title: The upload was cut off
uploadCut.body: The upload didn't finish, perhaps because of the connection, and nothing was saved. You can try again.

uploadErrors.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This type of file can't be imported. You can upload an XLSX or CSV file.
uploadErrors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 20 MB. You can split it in two.
uploadErrors.FILE_TOO_MANY_UPLOADS: You have many files whose upload didn't finish. Wait a moment and try again.
uploadErrors.ANOTHER_IMPORT_RUNNING: Another import is running now, so a new file can't be uploaded until it ends.
uploadErrors.FILE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: The file service isn't available right now. You can try again shortly.
uploadErrors.FILE_NOT_UPLOADED: The file didn't arrive in full. You can upload it again.
uploadErrors.FILE_UPLOAD_EXPIRED: The upload took too long. You can upload it again.
uploadErrors.TOO_MANY_DRAFTS: You have 5 unfinished imports, or the organization has 20. Complete or cancel them before uploading another file; a review that isn't confirmed ends after 24 hours.

progress.leaveNote: You can leave this page or close the browser; the import continues on our side, and its progress also shows at the top of the users list.

progress.stopRequested: You asked to stop the import; we stop after the current batch.

progress.undoingBody: We're removing the people this import added who haven't accepted their invitation, and restoring the previous data of the users it updated. You can leave this page.

result.someFailed: The file was imported except {count, plural, one {{count, number, integer} row with errors} other {{count, number, integer} rows with errors}}. Each row's reason is in the error report; you can fix them and import them again.

result.failedImporter: The import stopped because the person who ran it is no longer Organization Admin or HR Manager. The people added before that stay, and the remaining rows are in the error report.
result.failedSystem: We couldn't finish the import because of a fault on our side, after several attempts. Nothing was lost of the people added, and the remaining rows are in the error report, so you can import them from it later.
result.undoNotAllowed: The undo stopped because the person who asked for it can no longer undo this import. What was undone stays undone; an Organization Admin can undo the rest until the undo period ends.
result.undoFailedSystem: We couldn't finish the undo because of a fault on our side, after several attempts. What was undone stays undone; you can ask for the undo again until the undo period ends.
result.undoneBody: We removed the people this import added who hadn't accepted their invitation, and restored the previous data of the updated users unless it changed since.
